security_audit.summary: All 67 static findings are false positives: they describe documentation, JavaScript template literals, expected file reads, or authorized Apify API access. The runner sends selected input and an authentication token to Apify; execution depends on a remote Actor whose implementation is not included. No evidence found of prompt injection, unauthorized secret collection, destructive operations, or malicious intent in the reviewed files.

content.user_title: Find and Filter Greenhouse Jobs by Company
content.value_statement: Comparing public job listings across company boards requires repeated searches and inconsistent exports. This skill uses an Apify Actor to retrieve structured Greenhouse records with configurable filters.
actual_capabilities: Submit company tokens, names, domains, or board URLs to the Apify Actor for public job retrieval.
Request individual job details from full Greenhouse posting URLs.
Configure company directory searches and live board verification through the documented input schema.
Configure title, location, department, workplace, employment, date, salary, and currency filters.
Request descriptions and application questions, sort records, and set total or per-company result limits.
Run synchronous requests with the Node helper or follow documented asynchronous API steps to retrieve dataset records.
limitations: Requires an Apify account and token; Actor usage is billed to that account.
The included runner delegates retrieval to a remote Actor; its implementation and live results were not verified in this audit.
Public Greenhouse data only; private, authenticated, and paywalled records are outside the documented scope.
Available salary and employment details depend on employer disclosures; large runs may require the asynchronous workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Retrieve a small company sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to retrieve up to 25 public jobs from [company board]. Show titles, locations, departments, and application links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect records from one known board.

prompt_templates.title: Filter roles across companies
prompt_templates.prompt: Find remote engineering jobs at [companies]. Exclude internship titles, limit results to 50, and show the newest published roles first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: combine board selection, filters, and sorting.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect selected postings
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve these Greenhouse postings: [job URLs]. Include plain-text descriptions and application questions, then summarize each role without submitting applications.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: request optional detail fields for specific postings.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a bounded asynchronous export
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an asynchronous export for [companies] with USD salaries above [annual amount]. Cap results at 200 and explain expected charges before execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: plan a larger export with salary and cost controls.

output_examples.input: Show a small sample from a selected company board.
output: Illustrative record, not a live result: Software Engineer at Example Company.
Location: London. Department: Engineering. Employment type: Full-time.
Publication date and application link appear when supplied by the source.

output_examples.input: Find remote roles with disclosed USD salaries.
output: Illustrative export summary, not a live result: results restricted to remote roles with disclosed USD pay.
Each record includes the available title, company, location, department, dates, and application link.
Jobs without a stated workplace arrangement are excluded by the remote filter.

best_practices: Start with one known company board and a 25-item limit; inspect returned fields before increasing scope.
Keep APIFY_TOKEN in the environment and submit only public search inputs, never cookies, sessions, or private account data.
Review Actor pricing, site terms, and applicable law before larger runs; use the asynchronous workflow when needed.
anti_patterns: Do not use searchQuery for job-title filtering; it searches the company directory. Use titleKeywords for role titles.
Do not treat missing salary, dates, or employment details as proof that a role lacks those attributes.
Do not use this workflow to access private records, send spam, or support unlawful discrimination.

faq.question: Does this skill run the scraper locally?
faq.answer: No. The local Node helper sends input to an Apify Actor and prints its returned dataset records.

faq.question: What do I need to run it?
faq.answer: The Node helper requires Node 18 or later and APIFY_TOKEN. The documentation also provides curl examples for Apify API calls.

faq.question: Can I look up one specific job?
faq.answer: Yes. Use jobDetails mode with full Greenhouse job URLs. A company board URL alone does not identify a specific posting.

faq.question: Does searchQuery filter job titles?
faq.answer: No. searchQuery matches company names or tokens in companySearch mode. Use titleKeywords and excludeTitleKeywords to filter job titles.

faq.question: Are salary and remote-work details always available?
faq.answer: No. These details depend on employer disclosures. Filtering by workplace arrangement excludes jobs without a stated arrangement.

faq.question: Is usage free, and can it handle large runs?
faq.answer: Apify bills Actor usage to your account. Synchronous calls wait up to 300 seconds; the documentation provides an asynchronous workflow for larger runs.
